saints.name: St. Valerian of Abbenza
saints.title: Bishop and Confessor
saints.shortBlurb: An aged African bishop who, rather than surrender the goods of the Church to the Arian Vandals, was cast out to die in the open road…
biography: Valerian was bishop of Abbenza in Roman Africa during the Arian persecution waged by the Vandal king Genseric in the fifth century. Though he was more than eighty years old, he was commanded to hand over the sacred vessels and books of his church, and when he steadfastly refused, he was driven out of the city.

It was forbidden, on the king's order, that anyone shelter him in house or field, so that the old bishop lay a long time in the public road under the open sky, and there he ended his life as a confessor of the Catholic faith.
saints.knownFor: An aged confessor of the faith under the Arian Vandal persecution.
